scripts.build:assets: bun run build:skill && bun run build:viewer
scripts.build:binary: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --outfile dist/relic
scripts.build:npm: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --target node --outfile packages/cli-node/dist/relic.js && node scripts/fix-shebang.mjs
scripts.dev:viewer:fixture: bun run build:viewer && bun run scripts/serve-relic-2-fixture.ts
scripts.publish:npm: bun run build:npm && cd packages/cli-node && npm publish --access public
scripts.build:pypi:linux-x64: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64-baseline --outfile packages/cli-python/relic/relic
scripts.build:pypi:linux-arm64: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --target bun-linux-arm64 --outfile packages/cli-python/relic/relic
scripts.build:pypi:macos-x64: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-x64-baseline --outfile packages/cli-python/relic/relic
scripts.build:pypi:macos-arm64: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile packages/cli-python/relic/relic
scripts.build:pypi:windows-x64: bun run build:assets && bun build packages/cli-node/src/bin.ts --compile --target bun-windows-x64-baseline --outfile packages/cli-python/relic/relic.exe
